title: per-meeting-job
description: One unit of summarization work: the fan-out (m3) emits exactly one per meeting key; the per-meeting agent (m4) consumes it.

disposition.description: new: no summary exists yet; already-done: fully processed, nothing to do; amend: a summary exists and must be rewritten in place

amend.description: present exactly when disposition is amend

summary.description: the existing summary file to rewrite in place — never a second file

coverage.description: the sources the existing summary was built from
